steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Find promising ideas and emerging innovators across India's campuses and communities.

steps.title: Develop
steps.text: Help participants strengthen their ideas through structured guidance and honest feedback.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Bring students closer to mentors, founders and ecosystem leaders who have built before them.

steps.title: Validate
steps.text: Expose ideas to industry and entrepreneurial perspectives that test what is real.

steps.title: Scale
steps.text: Create pathways toward incubators, investors and the opportunities that follow.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Take the strongest ideas toward the national stage — and into the world.
